# React.dev

> > Official React documentation and community hub, featuring conference events, talks from the React team at Meta, and resources for React and React Native development.

React.dev is the official website for React, the JavaScript library for building user interfaces. The site hosts documentation, community events like React Conf, and resources for developers working with React, React Native, and server components.

## Key Topics

- React
- React Native
- Server Components
- React Conf
- Meta
- Evan Bacon
- Joe Savona
- Josh Story
- Ricky Hanlon
- Kent C. Dodds
- Lauren Tan
- Henderson Nevada
- Community Events
- Callstack
- React Team

- [React Conf 2025 | October 7-8 | Henderson, Nevada & online | Join us!](https://conf.react.dev/): React Conf 2025 event page: Oct 7-8 in Henderson, NV with online access
